B.text: An agent that verifies a flagged card and freezes it, in the customer's language, for bank fraud teams, so that prevented loss replaces write-offs.

C.text: A UAE retail bank's fraud engine flags a card transaction at 2 AM and the alert queues for the morning shift. An analyst calls at 9 AM - seven hours later. By then the fraudster has already called posing as the bank and moved 'safe' funds. The card is used again at 4 AM for AED 12,000; total loss AED 14,500, which the bank eats under CBUAE unauthorized-transaction rules. The customer loses trust and switches banks. The 60-second SLA fraud teams promise on paper does not exist in practice: the call channel is human, asynchronous and English-only.

G.text: We assumed detection was the bottleneck. It is not - the call is. We assumed banks wanted a fully autonomous freeze agent; every bank we spoke to requires a human specialist before any irreversible action. So the agent executes only a pre-approved temporary hold, then hands off.

rows: Opening disclosure: recorded call, the bank's AI assistant identifies itself and states why
Agent states the flagged transaction - merchant, amount, date - and asks: is this yours?
'Not mine' - agent executes the pre-approved temporary card freeze and says so
'It's mine' - agent closes the review, releases the hold, records the outcome
(H) Warm handoff: specialist joins with transcript, verification result, sentiment flag

J.why: STT has to hear 'not mine' in six languages (scribe_v2); TTS has to say the disclosure back in the customer's own language.

PAGE5.failures_heading: Dependency failure modes - what degrades, what never happens

failures.label: ElevenLabs TTS or STT down
failures.value: Phone turns keep playing through Twilio's own <Say> voice and the browser demo falls back to speechSynthesis (src/lib/voice-client.ts: speakText -> browserSpeak). /api/twilio/audio returns 503. Nothing is acted on silently.

failures.label: Twilio down or unconfigured
failures.value: The intervention takes the audit-only path (src/app/api/interventions/route.ts:238): the case is recorded, no call is placed, delivery is retried on 5xx. Live state: telephony=api-key, so this is a fallback, not today's default.

failures.label: Postgres (Prisma) down
failures.value: Fail closed: the audit append fails, the route returns 503 and the signal is rejected for safety (interventions/route.ts:211). No freeze and no call happen without an audit row.
